description: This bar chart illustrates the percentage of bias across different contact conditions and time points. The horizontal axis represents the contact condition, with categories labeled “No Contact Before,” “Positive Contact Before,” “Negative Contact Before,” “Virtual Contact,” and includes a final category “No Contact After” with labels ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Bias Percentage” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The chart consists of grouped bars for each contact condition, with each group containing three bars representing “No Contact Before” (light gray), “Positive Contact Before” (red), and “Negative Contact Before” (blue). For “No Contact Before,” the bar height is 39.50, 40.61, and 36.13 respectively. For “Positive Contact Before,” the bar heights are 0.04, 0.11, and 10.02 respectively. For “Negative Contact Before,” the bar heights are 0.00, 0.00, and 10.00 respectively. For “Virtual Contact,” the bar heights are 42.38, 47.28, and 43.83 respectively. The bars are grouped together by contact condition, and each group is visually distinguished by color according to the legend. The “No Contact After” bars are hatched and have heights of 31.83, 39.17, and 39.74 respectively.
